scripts.typecheck: tsc -b --pretty false && tsc -p tsconfig.domain.json && tsc -p tsconfig.firebase.json && tsc -p tsconfig.e2e.json && tsc -p functions/tsconfig.tests.json
scripts.emulators: npm run build:functions && node scripts/run-firebase-emulators.mjs emulators:start --only auth,firestore,functions --project demo-ats-loja-digital
scripts.test:rules: node scripts/run-firebase-emulators.mjs emulators:exec --only auth,firestore --project demo-ats-loja-digital "npm run test:rules:vitest"
scripts.test:firebase: node scripts/run-firebase-emulators.mjs emulators:exec --only auth,firestore --project demo-ats-loja-digital "npm run test:firebase:vitest"
scripts.test:integration: node scripts/run-firebase-emulators.mjs emulators:exec --only auth,firestore --project demo-ats-loja-digital "npm run test:integration:vitest"
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.test:commercial: node scripts/run-firebase-emulators.mjs emulators:exec --only auth,firestore --project demo-ats-loja-digital "npm run test:commercial:vitest"
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build:functions && node scripts/run-firebase-emulators.mjs emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,functions --project demo-ats-loja-digital "npm run test:e2e:playwright"
scripts.test:functions: npm run build:functions && node scripts/run-firebase-emulators.mjs emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,functions --project demo-ats-loja-digital "npm run test:functions:vitest"
